criteria.reasoning: The memo's numerator is "Program service expenses ... $19,066,000" less "donated food expensed in program services (14,180,000)" = "$4,886,000", and its denominator is $20,515,000 less "all gifts in kind expensed ($14,180,000 food + $95,000 legal) (14,275,000)" = "$6,240,000". It does not remove depreciation or any other non-gift-in-kind item.

The memo reports "$4,886,000 ÷ $6,240,000 = 78.3%". It mentions the unadjusted 92.9% only as "The unadjusted Form 990 program share" and says "only the policy-basis figure of 78.3% may be published", so 92.9% is clearly not presented as the policy ratio.
The summary table shows the program expense ratio target as "No", and section 3.1 says "Target: 80.0% or higher. Not met."

The contributions table includes "Less: bequest from the Estate of Harriet M. Okafor (600,000)". The memo ties this to the policy ("Under §3.2 of the policy, the CFO reports it to the committee separately") and says the bequest is "non-recurring". The memo never quotes the exclusion rule word for word, but it does tie the removal to the policy's bequest provision and gives the non-recurring rationale.
The memo's denominator is $18,930,000 less $14,345,000 noncash contributions less the $600,000 bequest = "$3,985,000".
The memo says "Target: $0.20 or less. Not met." and treats the $0.25 trigger only as a separate threshold that is "not reached".

The reserve starts from "Net assets without donor restrictions, end of year (Part X, line 27, col. B) $6,612,000". The memo says "Net assets with donor restrictions are excluded, as the policy requires" and names the $1,240,000 only as the excluded amount.

The memo computes "Operating reserve $1,504,000" as $6,612,000 less $5,108,000 net fixed assets. The $904,000 figure appears only in a labelled staff comment on what the reserve "would be" without the bequest; it is not the reported reserve.
The memo computes annual operating expenses as $20,515,000 − $446,000 − $14,275,000 = "$5,794,000" and gives the monthly figure as "$482,833".

The memo reports "$1,504,000 ÷ $482,833 = 3.1 months". The 1.9-month figure appears only as an explicit hypothetical ("Without it, the reserve would be ... about 1.9 months") and is not the reported result.
The summary table marks the reserve target "Yes", and section 3.3 says "Target: 3.0 months or more. Met."

Every figure comes from the files or is computed from them. That includes the sensitivity figures (about $797,000 = 0.20 × $3,985,000; $4,992,000 = 80% × $6,240,000; $904,000 and 1.9 months without the bequest), the $47,000 event expenses, the $1,581,000 of available assets and the $500,000 credit line. The memo explicitly says "The files do not show the prior year's indicators" rather than inventing them.
